items.text: – Clach mharmoil. Tha marmol a' ciallachadh glè dhaor.
items.q: A boy is meant to mispronounce 'marble' and think it means expensive. Is 'marmol' a natural child's slip of 'marmor', still recognizable?
before: Chaidh sinn air adhart a-rithist. Bha taigh ann letheach slighe. Bha am balla àlainn. Chanadh Ghassem:
